meta.label: Demo company / Synthetic data
meta.business: B2B SaaS: workflow approvals and automation for small teams; seat-based Starter / Team / Scale plans, monthly or annual billing, 14-day trials
meta.cash_week_convention: Consecutive 7-day weeks Sunday–Saturday from 2026-11-01; W13 ends 2027-01-30.
cash_rules: Known items: payouts in transit, processor balance, open AR, open AP, unfunded October payroll, signed vendor contract cycles and the signed future-start contract.
Renewals are forecast only after each subscription's current paid period ends, so prepaid annual service (deferred revenue) is never collected twice.
Subscriptions with a scheduled cancellation produce no renewal; past-due invoices are recovered at 50%.
October cloud, ads and vendor bills are already in AP (due Nov 15–20); recurring drivers start with November bills, paid in December.
Each known obligation has a unique deduplication key; open requisitions are a separate scenario line, not actual employees.
Equity funding is excluded; no new financing is assumed.
meta.pricing: v1 → v2 (+11–12%) for new customers from 2026-04-01; legacy renewals move from 2026-07-01, every seventh customer keeps v1.

kpi_monthly.description: Monthly SaaS, P&L, billing, cash and balance-sheet metrics, all recomputed from raw sources (USD).

pnl_monthly.description: General-ledger activity by P&L account vs the immutable original budget (approved 2024-10-20).

mrr_by_plan.grain: month × plan × billing interval × price version

cohorts.description: MRR of each first-paid cohort (new logos in the window; reactivations excluded) and MRR retention vs month 0.

headcount.description: Actual employees at month end vs original FTE plan.

cash_forecast_items.description: 13-week cash forecast line items (Known / Estimate / Scenario) with basis and source ID.

rows.basis: Initiated 30 Oct, expected arrival date from the processor

data_sources.description: Simulated source systems feeding the model.

rows.name: Stripe Billing
rows.description: Customers, effective prices, versioned subscriptions, trials, invoices, credits and dunning
rows.policy: Primary commercial/billing events; not accounting revenue or bank cash

rows.name: Stripe Payments
rows.description: Successful captures, failed intents, refunds, balance transactions and payouts
rows.policy: Processor settlement and customer cash; not earned revenue

rows.name: Order forms & contracts
rows.description: Committed service terms and dated amendments
rows.policy: Bookings policy; not MRR or expected CRM pipeline

rows.name: Revenue subledger
rows.description: Invoice-line and credit-line performance obligation schedules
rows.policy: Schedules including future unearned amounts; actuals only where status actual_earned

rows.name: Product analytics
rows.description: Organizations, assigned seats, users, onboarding and daily activity
rows.policy: Product usage; purchased seats differ from active users; no usage-billed add-ons

rows.name: HubSpot CRM
rows.description: Assisted accounts, owners, opportunities and stage history
rows.policy: Won signature links to contracts; open pipeline is expectation only

rows.name: AWS billing
rows.description: Daily cloud costs, monthly invoices, resource pools and tenant/shared allocations
rows.policy: Source cost; allocations and AP copies do not create more expense

rows.name: Gusto payroll
rows.description: Employees, effective salaries, earned payroll, allocations and actual funding
rows.policy: Earned employer cost versus actual bank funding; model tax assumptions

rows.name: QuickBooks
rows.description: Opening TB, double-entry GL, AP, accounting mirrors, prepayments and fixed assets
rows.policy: Authoritative actual financial statements; multiple source representations are not additive

rows.name: Operating bank
rows.description: Opening cash, posted statement and monthly cash balances
rows.policy: Actual bank cash only; process payouts in transit excluded

rows.name: Meta Ads
rows.description: Campaigns, daily spend, platform attribution and monthly bills
rows.policy: Platform trial claims may overlap with Google claims; no accounting revenue attribution

rows.name: Google Ads
rows.description: Campaigns, daily spend, micros, platform attribution and monthly bills
rows.policy: USD micros / 1e6; platform claims not deduplicated across platforms

rows.name: First-party tracking
rows.description: Captured leads and observable first/assisting touches
rows.policy: Known links only; unmatched leads and privacy gaps remain explicit

rows.name: Vendor contracts
rows.description: Effective recurring vendor contracts and price histories
rows.policy: Future committed cycles; do not duplicate existing AP

rows.name: Budget & plans
rows.description: Immutable monthly budget, FTE plan, open requisitions and known obligations
rows.policy: Plans and commitment copies are not actual hires/payments/expenses
